units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:1:6">Y. Sot. I, beg. 16ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>מצא</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:1">Deut. XXIV, 1</cite>) <he>אין מ׳ בכל מקום וכ׳</he> ‘finding’ means everywhere ascertaining through witnesses.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:3">Gitt. V, 3</cite> <he>המוצא מ׳ לא ישבע</he> the finder of a lost object cannot be made subject to an oath (if the owner claims more).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 8a:22">B. Mets. 8ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00049"><he>גָּבַהּ</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְצִיאוֹת</he>.
Ib. II, 1 אלו מ׳ שלו וכ׳ the following things if found belong to the finder, and the following must be published; a. fr.—Trnsf. precious things.—Pl. as ab.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50:10">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> (ref. to <he>הנמצאות</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 19:15">Gen. XIX, 15</cite>) <he>שתי מ׳ וכ׳</he> two precious acquisitions, Ruth &c.; <cite ref="Genesis 19:15">ib.</cite> s. 41; Yalk. ib. 70; 84.
